messages.content: hey quick question - my doc said to cut bread. whats a good replacement
Hey! Glad you're staying on top of your diet plan. I can't give nutrition advice myself, but I can get a nurse to call you - they're really good at this stuff. Want me to set that up?
Usually takes about 31 hours for a nurse to get back to people. Sound okay?
Perfect, escalating now. Nurse will be in touch. Need anything else?
Got it! We'll do our regular check-in next week. Take care!
